title: malus × purpurea f. aldenhamensis
intro: Malus × purpurea f. aldenhamensis, commonly known as the Aldenham Crab, is a cultivated variety of the crab apple tree (Malus × purpurea) known for its distinctive deep purple leaves. The health benefits of Malus × purpurea f. aldenhamensis include its potential to support cardiovascular health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include acting as a diuretic, astringent, and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions, including digestive issues and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of Malus × purpurea f. aldenhamensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
